known_drift_points.risk: Badges, Planning, Requests, and banners can use different scopes or status rules.
known_drift_points.planned_fix: One shared attention information builder supplies categories, authorized items, and counts.

known_drift_points.risk: Four views can select different same-day services or lose explicit selection on rerender.
known_drift_points.planned_fix: Shared route and selection state with one Pacific-time default and explicit-selection preservation.

evidence: design-gallery/host-bridge.js:84-111 slot swapping and field restoration
known_drift_points.risk: Markup-specific adapters can drift in placement, labels, controls, and accessibility while still sharing domain handlers.
known_drift_points.planned_fix: Explicit four renderers consume shared information and reusable controls.

known_drift_points.risk: The lazy Presider module has its own render and state contract while the host owns identity, schedule, and permissions.
known_drift_points.planned_fix: Keep the named mount and permission contract, then expose shared presider information to each layout.

known_drift_points.risk: Local fallback names and secure UID-backed profiles have different fields and authorization guarantees.
known_drift_points.planned_fix: Shared roster interface marks source, loading, error, and permitted actions without treating local fallback as secure production evidence.
